title: Quest Diagnostics confirms data breach exposed patient records
description: Quest Diagnostics, a major American clinical laboratory company, disclosed a data breach involving unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system, resulting in exposure of patient records. The breach was confirmed publicly but specific technical details and affected versions were not provided. No known exploits or active attacks have been reported. The incident highlights risks to sensitive healthcare data due to unauthorized system access.
aiSummary: Quest Diagnostics experienced a data breach where a threat actor gained unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system, exposing patient records. The disclosure does not include detailed technical information about the breach vector, exploited vulnerabilities, or affected software versions. There is no indication of known exploits in the wild or further technical indicators. The breach involves sensitive healthcare data, raising concerns about patient privacy and regulatory compliance.
aiImpact: Exposure of patient records can lead to privacy violations, potential identity theft, and regulatory consequences for Quest Diagnostics. The breach compromises sensitive personal and medical information, which can have serious implications for affected individuals. No evidence of exploitation beyond unauthorized access has been reported.
